note: Every pre-extraction lifecycle obligation, with its source and its single home. Discipline duties move into the mission-* family; orchestration duties stay in factory-mission. Re-derived from source during verify (iteration 2); D4 was dropped as not an obligation of the two cited sources and replaced by the real no-test-surface rule.

D1.text: Mission Brief becomes a spec artifact: goal, constraints, non-goals, and success criteria stated as measurable outcomes.

D2.text: Spec ambiguities are clarified before planning.

D3.text: Spec becomes an ordered plan naming the files the change touches.

D4.text: The test/code split is skipped only when the run declares no test surface (tdd: false, docs/config-only work, or interactive mode).

D5.text: Test Agent writes the failing suite; source is mounted read-only.

D6.text: RED gate: at least one test fails before any implementation exists.

D7.text: Implement Agent writes the minimum source; tests and plan (and the spec) are mounted read-only.

D8.text: GREEN gate: the full suite passes before converge.

D9.text: A GREEN failure loops back to the code step with the failure list, bounded by the mission's code-step retry cap and not consuming the converge circuit breaker.

D10.text: An independent judge checks the work against the Brief and the Non-Goals.

D11.text: Converge returns one of DONE, CONTINUE or SPEC_CORRECTION_NEEDED.

D12.text: DONE requires quality at or above the configured threshold.

D14.text: SPEC_CORRECTION_NEEDED routes to the owning clarify gate, never to code.
D14.source: mitigation constraint G4 in the extraction issue (correction route retained); factory-mission/SKILL.md Phase 5 SPEC_CORRECTION_NEEDED

O1.text: Issue pull, dispatch/gating label gate, dependency hard gate.

O2.text: Brief persisted to the run directory as a draft.

O3.text: Worktree isolation, atomic git ref lock, committer identity, authorship preservation.

O7.text: Hierarchical context parameters and their disclosure.

O9.text: Comment-bus publishing per output_type; drafts stay local.

O10.text: Autonomous decision recording and the never-decide list.

O11.text: Completion write-back, audit trail, labels, agent-authored stamp, mr_url, no auto-merge.

O12.text: MR ownership: milestone and assignee propagation, preserve-only.

O13.text: Worktree cleanup and lease release on every exit path.
